name: Joshua Rotenberg
body: What drew me to this role is the line about iterating on sequences and messaging based on what's working in real conversations. That's how I've always done my best work: building the process while doing the job. At Wix I helped build the process for a new vertical while running onboarding, and it went from proof of concept to a profitable business line. At my consulting business, Solenzo, I built my outbound system while running outbound myself, segmenting campaigns by trigger and refining them as I went.

I'm also comfortable on the phone and I hit numbers. I made up to 150 calls a day and closed up to 10 deals a month at Fivestars, hit 120% of target at Wix, ranked top three on a team of 8 to 15 at Accelo while quota roughly doubled, and spent four years as a BDR booking meetings for reps. And I know your buyer: I work with trade contractors (electrical, plumbing, HVAC) and know how much time owners lose chasing paperwork instead of running jobs.
I'm in Colorado, one hour off Pacific time, and comfortable working West Coast hours. I'd welcome a conversation at 303-726-5037 or jrotnbrg@gmail.com.
